about: AA-853 owner decisions for the schema drift report (db/schema_drift.py) and the replay (db/replay_migrations.py). decisions: one entry per finding the owner has decided on: id (exact finding id as drift.json prints it, or a glob with *), class (unmanaged | missing | changed; default: any), owner (owners.yaml key), decision (keep | drop | write-migration | baseline | other text), ref (Linear issue), note. A decided finding is no longer counted as open. baseline: SQL files under db/replay_baseline/ that recreate what a lost migration made (the AA-ACP-App lineage deleted in S241, and hand DDL recorded only in the root repo archive), each run as the master right before `before` (a registry key, an owner file or "start"), generated by db/gen_replay_baseline.py: file, before, owner, reason, ref. replay_order: registered files whose registry applied_at is not when they ran (back-registered rows, description `backfill: …`, `keys`) or unregistered legacy files whose name-order place is not when they ran (`files`, owner/file), moved before `before` (a registry key or an owner file) in the order listed: keys | files, before, owner, reason (with the evidence), ref. Change this file by PR; the owner of the schema approves.

decisions.note: Exemption (S251 D2): LangGraph's own migration counter, created at runtime by PostgresSaver.setup() of the old S2 graph (AA-43), not by a CIS migration. CIS 122 dropped the three LangGraph data tables and kept this one on purpose ('LangGraph-library-owned bookkeeping, not something this app's migrations should manage'). No code reads it; dropping it is a separate cleanup decision.

001's v1 layer (registered with v1.0-v3.0 on 2026-04-20); dropped by hand on Dev before the registry existed. CIS 281 drops it where the running role may (and the schema's tables are empty); on a database migrated by DB Migrate the schema is the RDS master's (001 ran as the master, 245 moves only the 12 CIS schemas), so 281, which runs as cis_owner, leaves it with a NOTICE. Owner decision: Dev's state (gone) is right; the leftover in a files-only database is an empty, unused legacy layer, not worth a master-run roles/ file.

baseline.reason: Hand DDL (S251): sprint S7 applied row level security on shared.pipeline_runs by hand (008's header, 21/04/2026: 'S7 applied RLS only on shared.pipeline_runs'); the repo's 004 cannot have run as written (uuid tenant_id compared with text). 239's guard checks that state. Placed before 008, which states it. Not codified by any CIS migration and it cannot be: 239 needs the state before 239 runs, so a later file (281) is too late. A database built from the migration files alone still lacks it and stops at 239 (files-only installs are not supported past 239); this replay stand-in exists only so 239 and 244 can run in the replay.

Lost lineage (S251 D1): the acp_* schemas, acp_shared.acp_runs / acp_hitl_requests / acp_output_rules, acp_silver_s2.visibility_reports, acp_silver_s3.content_calendars and acp_silver_s4.blog_drafts were created by AA-ACP-App, deleted in S241 (AA-867); no surviving repo holds their DDL. Placed right before the first replayed file that needs any of them (020 seeds acp_output_rules): the latest point the evidence fixes.

Lost lineage (S251 D1): gold_aa_internal.tenant_tour_versions has no creating file in any repo; 107 is the first file that changes it. Shape = live minus what 107, 109 and 175 add, with the status CHECK as it was before 108.

Hand DDL (S251): silver_aa_internal.raw_sources.file_hash was added by hand before 123 (2026-08-28), whose header says the column was 'already live via manual DDL'; 123 only indexes it. CIS 281 codifies the column.

Hand DDL (S251): AA-598 G3 dropped acp_shared.unknown_ledger on 16/09/2026 (root repo docs/archive/2026/audit-cis-g3-execute.sql). No registry row on 16-17/09: before 153, the first after. CIS 281 codifies the drop.

Hand DDL (S251): AA-603 dropped content_metric_snapshot, acp_deliver.pieces / packets, acp_v2_slots, acp_v2_runs on 21/09/2026 (root repo docs/archive/2026/aa603-drop-n7n8-tables.sql); 244's guard lists the RLS tables left after it. Before 160, the first registry row of 21/09 (a lower bound). CIS 281 codifies the drop.
